name: due-work-harness
description: Generate standardized DueWorkContract tests for lost work, duplicate effects, and recovery failures in Python applications.

interface.longDescription: DueWorkContract turns a Python application's real workflow and recovery path into a standardized pytest suite. It generates cases for lost work, worker crashes, uncertain external calls, duplicate effects, and other lifecycle and replay-safety failures; your coding agent can also use the harness's fault-injection tools to write focused tests for your domain. Ask whether a Celery task can disappear after a Django commit, a retry can charge twice, or a Kafka consumer can process a message twice after an offset-commit failure. The core accepts plain Python callables without assuming a framework, queue, database, or business domain. Optional adapters expose specific boundaries in Django/PostgreSQL, django-tasks, Celery, RQ/Redis, MongoDB, Prefect, and aiokafka. Shopify and other external APIs can be tested through the application's real call and observable effects; no released Shopify-specific adapter is included. Proofs require a coding environment with the target repository and appropriate test services, not a hosted MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Can this Celery task get lost after the Django transaction commits?
Could a retry charge twice or send a duplicate receipt?
Test whether this Kafka consumer repeats work after a crash.
